title: s06 + s07 m3: one noir cue from the speakeasy through the seminar to the alley, split at the s06/s07 cut sample
notes: Liam on m2: the lecture has no music and is more boring; keep the speakeasy music going through, a little quieter under the lecture, back up on the cut to the dark alley.
One render on a joint timeline (s06 663 frames + s07 1000 frames at 30 fps = 1,060,800 + 1,600,000 samples at 48 kHz); the music stem is split at joint sample 1,060,800 (the s06/s07 cut).

Treatment = m2 (conspiracy m4c): cue mono fold, high-pass 100 Hz, high shelves 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS (whole filtered cue); under speech -29.3 LUFS, +5 dB between words; sidechain from the dialogue of both scenes as one key (10 ms RMS, -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release), so the release runs across the cut.

s06: m2's placement unchanged (track 84.160 s at scene 0.236 s, 5 ms raised-cosine head, bar 23 on frame 9, bar 28 on the door shut, frame 576); m2's fade at 19.40-19.70 is removed, so the bed plays under the slot slam, REJECTED and the freeze and on into s07.

Length: the cue is 126.4 s and its body ends at bar 32 (about 118.4 s; a pause, then the final chord at 120.8 s). 84.16 + 55.43 s would need track 139.6 s, so one bar-aligned loop: bar 29 (106.926 s, a phrase start) -> bar 1 (2.830 s, the theme's first bar; chroma of the bar 0.93 like bar 29's), measured flux downbeats (180 Hz high-pass), equal-power 50 ms crossfade ending 5 ms before the downbeat. The loop lands at s07 0.902 s, inside the 1 s ramp down, under the lecture.

Lecture (s07 0 to frame 774): -4 dB on the whole sidechain (under speech -33.3 LUFS), reached by a 1.0 s ramp (linear in dB) from the cut; the ramp starts at s06's level as delivered (join_comp_db = s06 scene gain - s07 scene gain, so the delivered music has no level step at the cut).

Alley (frame 774 on): back to 0 dB (-29.3 under speech) over a linear-in-dB ramp from the cut that lands on bar 8's downbeat (the continuous grid puts it 0.44 s after the cut; no downbeat can land on the cut without a splice, so m2's bar 5 on the cut is not kept). m2's raised-cosine fade 33.14 s to the last frame is kept.
Stamps as m2 (REJECTED 0 -> -2 dB, VERSION 3 -6 -> -8 dB); all effects unchanged from m2 (null against m2's sfx stems).
Program -16 LUFS per scene, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (finish-m3.py per scene); AAC 192k on master and phone.
